ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ratio primarily localized at the distal tips; approximately 95 percent low-intensity (black/dark-grey) to 5 percent high-intensity (white/calcified).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniform dark-grey field across both lobes. Discrete high-intensity pixel clusters are mapped to the extreme distal tips of both lobes. A localized, diffuse high-intensity mottle is visible on the inner trailing edge of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a calculated vertex angle of approximately 50 degrees and a significant depth relative to the lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Left lobe trailing edge displays high-frequency, irregular serrations; right lobe trailing edge exhibits lower-frequency peaks and a smoother contour towards the notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex sweep from the water line to the mid-section, transitioning to a slight concavity at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Symmetric, high-contrast clusters of circular white pixel groups (barnacle colonization) localized on the superior margin of both lobe tips.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive calcified barnacle clusters present on the apical regions of both fluke lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: A localized patch of white pigmentation or mottling on the right lobe, situated approximately 20 percent of the distance from the tip along the trailing edge.
